Canonical package authority is bounded to the approved expression; channel, homepage, commerce, Figma and consumer work remain excluded.
Olli kept all 23 Round 03 specimens and H-EXP-05-TRADING-CARD-PROOF is closed by DEC-TRADING-CARD-EXPRESSION-001.

qualityDimensions.evidence: Public product names, exact Wings and complete product fields remain the dominant reading order.
Faces, useful backs, decks and real placements share one bounded anatomy without restoring killed editions.
Mobile and desktop proof preserve geometry, no overflow and exactly one live core.
Three exact round receipts, the approval record, canonical source, package and roadmap agree.
